name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: Enact the already_done on-issue disposition and gate BOTH dispositions on a strong-reason guard. In addition to the durable triage_memory skip, an already_done IMPLEMENT handoff now composes a reason from artifact.ref (the on-main evidence commit) and calls work_intake.gh_issue_already_done_sink(issue_ref, repo, reason) via the injectable DEFAULT_ALREADY_DONE_SINK seam, trust-gated by permits('file', mode) (dry-run logs intent, no sink call; propose/auto-merge posts), leaving the issue OPEN. A strong-reason guard (work_intake.is_strong_reason) is applied before enacting AND before recording the terminal triage_memory status on BOTH the already_done and the reject dispositions: a weak reason (or an already_done handoff with no artifact.ref evidence) is not enacted and not recorded, so the item re-works next tick. A strong reason enacts+records exactly as before (regression).
spec_no_change_reason: Spec content already committed for this cycle in b340843 (already_done on-issue disposition + strong-reason guard); this cycle bumps feature.json to 0.48.0 + adds the CHANGELOG 0.48.0 entry + re-anchors the housekeep spec.md baseline to 1566.
